pay_detail: Stipend check mailed after each event. Amount not stated.
name: Job Training Program (Photography)
what_you_do: Get paid to photograph events for local groups and businesses, with a teaching artist mentoring you. Youth in Focus provides all the camera equipment.
who_can_apply: Teens who take part in Youth in Focus programs (ages 13 to 19) and have finished at least one of its free after-school photography classes.
deadline_text: No deadline. Take a class first, then ask about jobs.
how_to_apply: Finish at least one free after-school class (register on the Class Registration page). Staff pick a student for each event and send the details.
notes: Classes are free or pay what you can, and equipment, snacks and bus passes are provided. The page does not say whether the stipend is treated as a job for work-permit purposes, so ask.
